scope: Read-only limited-context coordinator trial. No scientific worker, test, analysis, job, mutation, commit, or publication was run. Post-trial evidence writing was separately authorized.
inventory_and_verification: Listed tracked paths in coordinator and study; inspected current HEAD and gitlink identities; verified inspected coordinator and selected study files had no differences from the cited revisions. No earlier commit contents were read.
exclusions: No prior chats, archived history, iteration contents, experiment-result contents, rehearsal outputs, or personal-file contents were inspected. execution_note: The first inventory command used the default login shell, which emitted shell-startup sourced notices. Subsequent commands used login=false. No shell-startup file contents were opened.
delegation_note: A read-only guidance cross-check was attempted but could not start because the agent thread limit was reached.
report_retention: The original task prompt and final report are retained verbatim, with terminal newlines. Conclusions were not revised.
